findings.evidence: Lines 158–161 supply f : F →+* 𝓞 K ⧸ P with F a finite field and P maximal. Thus #F = p^a and absNorm P = p^b, giving gcd(p^b, p^a − 1) = 1.
findings.fix: Remove hP from the signature and derive it internally from f and the finite-field cardinalities; simplify its caller in Relation.lean.
findings.issue: Ideal.exists_mulChar_mk_eq unnecessarily requires hP: the field embedding f forces F and the residue field to have the same characteristic p, so their cardinalities are powers of p and N P is automatically coprime to #F − 1.

findings.evidence: Lines 250–252 assume both ideals maximal and 𝔓.LiesOver P. Writing their norms as p^a and p^b, with positive exponents, hP implies p ∤ n and hence (absNorm 𝔓).Coprime n.
findings.fix: Keep hP, remove h𝔓 from the signature, and derive the latter internally; remove the corresponding argument in Relation.lean.
findings.issue: Ideal.powerResidueSymbol_ringHomComp_eq_pow unnecessarily requires h𝔓 in addition to hP: primes related by LiesOver have residue fields of the same characteristic, so their norms have the same prime divisor.

summary: Two new APIs require coprimality proofs already implied by their field maps, imposing unnecessary obligations on callers.
